skills.summary: Checks objective-to-standard alignments and professional-source references against live-verified registries; missing, protected or unverified sources become honest gaps.
triggers: Map a unit, course or module to standards
Check NBEA ten-area or ISTE educator-role coverage
Check whether a standard edition or identifier is right
Review a document that names educator organizations
boundaries: Does not decide what a standard's text means for a lesson; the teacher of record reviews it
Stores no protected standard or assessment text
Never records memberships or credentials
inputs: Alignment JSON (objective, criterion, record id, standard id, status)
method: Validate both registries
Compute the supported status per row from source status, identifier scheme, audience, edition and adoption, and human review
Mark overclaims as errors
Report NBEA or ISTE label coverage
Check organization names and relations
stopping_conditions: Every row has a supported status and every error is fixed or kept as a recorded gap
A needed source is unreachable: keep the gap and name the human resume step
skills.output_contract: JSON with ok, errors, coverage (verified|partial|gap), supported counts, per-objective best status and per-row findings; exit 0 ok, 1 findings or invalid, 2 usage.

skills.summary: Student-data policy adapter: decides whether a workflow may read one student-related record under company-fleets tenant rules and the school's verified policy.
triggers: Before any roster, grade, accommodation or learner-work task
Before sending anything student-related anywhere

Authorizes no real record until a named human verifies the school policy

skills.summary: Builds a runnable school CS lesson package and responds to supplied learner work with executed, specific feedback; never invents learner responses or progress.
triggers: A CS teacher needs a lesson or lab for a recorded grade band
Feedback is needed on learner code, a prediction or a trace the learner actually supplied
A CS answer key or worked example needs executing before use
boundaries: Does not invent learner responses, grades or learning gains
Passing tests, typing speed, memorized syntax or AI output are not evidence of understanding
Does not verify the teaching assignment or certification; records them as unverified
Cites CSTA by label and link only; no standards text
University (CS2023) expectations need a bridge via edu-learning-progression
Handles synthetic or teacher-supplied work only; real student records go through the school's approved process
inputs: Objective, grade band, prior knowledge, duration and actual environment
Teaching assignment status (PA CSPG 71 for CS 7-12)
Supplied learner work JSON for respond
method: State the objective and prior knowledge
Show a complete runnable example
Ask the learner to predict, trace, modify, explain or construct
Wait for the actual response
Run lesson.py respond and give feedback quoting the actual output
Adjust support with decision points and misconception probes
Assess transfer with a new problem
Run lesson.py check before use
stopping_conditions: respond returned one status for the supplied work; the next step waits for the learner
Python unavailable: deliver the package marked unexecuted
skills.output_contract: check prints {ok, errors, examples, task_runs}; respond prints {status, feedback, next_action, tests, misconceptions, progress_claim: null} with status awaiting-learner-response, tests-failing, prediction-differs, not-yet-evidence-of-understanding or ready-for-teacher-review.
failure_states: Exit 2 invalid input: unreadable JSON, missing task_id or an undefined task
Exit 1 from check: wrong stated output, rubric accepting passing code, teacher standard on a student objective, bundled standards text, missing alternative or transfer task
Learner code timing out after 5 seconds is a failing test

skills.summary: Checks a prerequisite map and course sequence: no cycles, prerequisites first, every concept assessed or flagged, and no university concept in a K-12 unit without a bridge.
triggers: Someone needs a prerequisite graph, curriculum map, scope and sequence or learning progression
A CS or BCIT program pathway spans grade bands or reaches university study
An instructional-design curriculum map needs a checked prerequisite graph
boundaries: Does not claim standards alignment; that belongs to edu-standards-alignment
Does not apply CS2023 to school learners without a written bridge
A coherent map is not evidence that learners learn in that order
Does not override a district's adopted sequence
inputs: Audience, grade band or setting, and course length
Concepts with band, prerequisites and assessing tasks
method: Start from the intended end performance
Name prerequisites and the assessing task per concept
Place concepts into units, prerequisites first
Write a bridge for any concept above its unit's band or move it
Run progression.py check and fix every error
Send program-level changes to faculty review
stopping_conditions: check exits 0 and every unassessed concept is resolved or accepted by a reviewer
A decision only a human can make (adopted sequence, standards) is handed off
skills.output_contract: JSON {ok, errors, warnings, unassessed, order, note}; order is a valid prerequisite order or null when a cycle exists.
failure_states: Exit 1: cycle, unknown or duplicate concept, prerequisite out of order, concept placed twice or unplaced, band jump without a bridge
Exit 2 invalid input: unreadable JSON, missing concepts or sequence, unknown band, non-numeric grade

skills.summary: Critiques education research, designs studies and evaluates BCIT or CS programs with traced citations, an overclaim lint, an ethics boundary and dimension-separated program conclusions.
triggers: Review or critique a computing-education or business-education study
Verify a paper's reference list
Draft a research question, method, instruments, analysis or ethics plan
Evaluate a BCIT or CS program's coherence, assessment validity, participation or evidence of learning
Decide what a study means for a K-12 or BCIT classroom
boundaries: Never claims IRB, REB or district approval and never collects or analyzes real participant data
Never presents a talk, association page or practitioner post as an established finding
Higher-education CS findings do not transfer to K-12 BCIT or workplace learning without a stated argument
Standards and credential mapping belong to edu-standards-alignment
inputs: Full paper by DOI, arXiv id or PDF
prerequisites: Network access to api.crossref.org and export.arxiv.org for live citation checks, or a recorded resolver
method: Classify the evidence type
Fill a study card from the methods and results sections and run the claims lint
Verify the paper's identifier and at least 10 references
Write the critique with the methods checklist
Offer classroom use only as a bounded hypothesis
Design mode: match method to question, then run the design check
Program mode: tag evidence by kind and dimension, then run the program check
stopping_conditions: Every claim and in-scope reference has a status
Design and program checks pass or list human decisions
Full paper inaccessible: stop and report blocked
skills.output_contract: Critique Markdown plus claims and citations JSON (verified, mismatch, unresolved counts); plan or program JSON with its check result. Script exit 0 ok, 1 blocking findings, 2 invalid input.
failure_states: Paper not accessible: blocked with the URL tried
Lookup failure or rate limit: unresolved with the reason
Title, year or author differs: mismatch naming the fields
Book without DOI: unverified by the tool
Invalid input: exit 2 naming the field
